quiz.0.question: Where did Gewürztraminer originate?
quiz.0.explanation: Gewürztraminer takes its name from the village of Tramin (Termeno) in Alto Adige. It is one of the world's most aromatic white grapes.
quiz.1.question: What production method does Trento DOC use?
quiz.1.explanation: Trento DOC uses Metodo Classico (secondary fermentation in bottle), producing Italy's finest mountain sparkling wines.
quiz.2.question: What is Trentino's most representative red grape variety?
quiz.2.explanation: Teroldego Rotaliano DOC is Trentino's flagship red — a bold, deeply coloured wine from the Campo Rotaliano plain.
quiz.3.question: Before 1919, Alto Adige was part of which empire?
quiz.3.explanation: Alto Adige (South Tyrol) was part of the Austro-Hungarian Empire until 1919, which is why Austrian grape varieties such as Gewürztraminer and Riesling thrive here.
